blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing human motion in 4D requires identifying the same surface points through articulation, deformation and changes in visibility. We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair from a set of monocular RGB images, without a body template. Trained specifically for human geometry, Dense4D jointly processes person-centred crops with known image-to-crop transforms to predict Human Point Maps (HPMs) and depth for each image. An HPM assigns each person pixel the 3D position of its observed surface point at a common reference time. These maps support amodal correspondence: points hidden in the reference image can be localised from observations in other frames. Matching HPM coordinates across crops establishes correspondence without predicting camera poses or large scene displacements; per-image depth then lifts the matches into 3D tracks. Experiments on real people demonstrate substantially higher tracking accuracy and closer agreement with scanned surfaces than the evaluated baselines. Points from different frames assemble into coherent human geometry in the reference pose, providing visible evidence of consistent dense correspondence through articulation and clothing deformation. Additional qualitative results, videos, and an interactive viewer are available at https://alpguler.com/dense4d.
blocks.zh: 在4D中重新构建人的运动需要通过发音,变形和能见度的变化来识别相同的地表点. 我们介绍Dense4D, 据我们所知,第一个Feed-forward的模型 专门处理全身密集的4D通信, 服装和发型来自一组单相机的 RGB 图像,没有身体模板. Dense4D专门为人类几何学进行训练,通过已知的图像到作物变换,共同处理以人为中心的作物,以预测人点地图(HPM)和每个图像的深度。 一个HPM在共同的参考时间为每个人分配其所观测到的地表点的3D位置像素. 这些地图支持一个模式对应:在参考图像中隐藏的点可以从其他框架的观察中定位. 匹配不同作物的HPM坐标可以建立通信,而无需预测相机的外观或大场景的相位;再将相克深度提升到3D轨道. 对真人进行的试验显示,与所评估的基线相比,跟踪准确度高得多,对被扫描的地表更接近一致。 来自不同框架的分点在参考姿势中组装成连贯的人类几何,通过表达和服装变形,提供了一致的密集相通的明显证据. 可在https://alpguler.com/dense4d上查阅更多的定性结果、录像和互动取景器。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A detailed understanding of human geometry and motion is important across many fields, including robotics, extended reality, entertainment, healthcare, sports analytics, and sign language understanding.
Yet people remain challenging for general dynamic scene reconstruction systems because their motion combines body articulation with the independent deformation of clothing and hair.
Following these surfaces through a video requires identifying the same points as they move, become occluded and reappear.
Reconstructing each frame independently does not establish this correspondence.
We study dense 4D human correspondence , the task of matching points across the body, clothing and hair in different images and recovering their three-dimensional trajectories.
blocks.zh:
对人类几何和运动的详细理解在许多领域都很重要,包括机器人、扩展现实、娱乐、保健、体育分析以及手语理解。
然而,人们对一般的动态场景重建系统仍然具有挑战性,因为他们的运动结合了身体的表达和衣被和发型的独立变形.
这些表面通过视频显示后,需要识别它们移动时的相同分点,被被被占据并重新出现.
独立地重建每个帧并不能建立此函证.
我们研究密集的 4D 人类通信, 任务 匹配点 整个身体, 衣服和头发 在不同的图像 和恢复他们的 三维轨迹。

blocks.en:
Human correspondence methods commonly map image pixels to a shared body template ( Güler et al., 2018 ) .
Such coordinates describe the underlying body, but do not directly represent the geometry and independent motion of loose garments and hair.
In parallel, many 4D dynamic scene reconstruction systems jointly estimate geometry, motion and cameras across diverse scenes ( Sucar et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
We introduce Dense4D for dense 4D human correspondence without a body template.
The model establishes correspondence on the person without jointly reconstructing the surrounding scene or predicting camera poses.
blocks.zh:
人类对应方法通常将图像像素映射到一个共享的身体模板上(Güler等,2018.
这种坐标描述的是下体,但不直接代表松散的衣被和发被的几何和独立的运动.
与此同时,许多4D动态场景重建系统共同估计了跨越不同场景的几何,运动和相机(Sucar等,2026;张等,2026.
我们引入了Dense4D,用于密集的4D人类通信,没有身体模板.
该模型在不共同重建周边场景或预测相机姿势的情况下建立人物上的通信.

blocks.en:
Dense4D follows a top-down approach: we isolate each person in the scene and jointly process their crops across time ( Fig. 2 ).
Using the focal length and person mask, a known virtual-camera warp reorients each crop towards the person, and the crop zoom is supplied to the network.
A Human Point Map (HPM) assigns each person pixel the 3D position of its observed surface point at a selected reference time, expressed in the reference crop’s camera coordinates.
These maps support amodal correspondence to the reference surface, including regions hidden in the reference image but observed in other frames.
Their union samples this reference-time geometry ( Fig. 1 , right).
blocks.zh:
Dense4D遵循自上而下的方法:我们隔离现场的每个人,并共同处理其作物跨时间(图2).
使用焦距和人物口罩,一个已知的虚拟相机曲面将每个作物重定向为人,并给网络提供作物缩放.
人相点地图(HPM)在选定的参考时间给每个人分配所观测到的地表点的3D位置像素,用参考作物相机坐标表示.
这些地图支持与参考地表的模式对应,包括参考地图中隐藏但在其他框中观察到的区域.
他们的联盟样本是这个参考时间几何(图1,右).

blocks.en:
Where methods such as V-DPM predict point motion in a shared camera frame ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) , Dense4D identifies corresponding pixels by matching HPM coordinates across person-centred crops.
The learned mapping relates observations of the person with known crop transforms and zoom, without also predicting the person’s displacement through the scene.
Each matched pixel is lifted with the depth predicted for its image to recover the 3D track position.
External scene geometry and camera poses are used separately to place the reconstructed person and tracks in world coordinates.
blocks.zh:
凡V-DPM等方法在共享相机相框中预测出点运动(Sucar等,2026),Dense4D通过匹配HPM坐标来识别相应的像素,跨越以人为中心的作物.
所学的绘图涉及已知作物变异和放大的人的观察,而没有预测此人在现场的迁移情况。
每个相匹配的像素被抬起并带有其图像的预想深度以恢复3D轨道位置.
外部场景几何和相机外形分别用于将被重建的人和轨道放入世界坐标.

blocks.en:
We use the image encoder and aggregator architecture of Wang et al. (2026) .
An additional crop token conditions the aggregator, which alternates attention within and across frames.
Two dense heads predict HPMs and per-image depth in a single forward pass.
Training uses human geometry and correspondence supervision from synthetic motion and multi-view renderings of real scans.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Wang等人(2026年)的图像编码和聚合架构.
额外的作物标志性条件为聚合物,在框内和框外交替注意.
两个密集的头部在一次前传中预测出HPM和活像深度.
训练使用从合成运动和多视图渲染出真扫描的人体几何和函授监督.

blocks.en:
Across articulated motion and clothing deformation, Dense4D brings observations from different frames into coherent reference-time human geometry, with visibly aligned body parts and fine surface details ( Sec. 4.4 ).
On real footage, Dense4D recovers more accurate human trajectories and better matches the scanned reference geometry than the methods we compare against ( Secs. 4.2 and 4.3 ).
The shared reference representation also supports tracking across long intervals, as demonstrated on an 86 s video ( Fig. 10 ).
blocks.zh:
Dense4D将不同框架的观测结果贯穿于清晰的运动和服装变形中,形成连贯的参考时间人类几何,身体部分明显对齐,表面细节细细(第4.4节)。
在真实的镜头上,Dense4D恢复了更准确的人类轨迹并比我们比较的方法更能匹配被扫描的参考几何(sec.4.2和4.3.).
如86 s视频所示(图10),共享的参考资料还支持跨长间隔跟踪。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: • We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to template-free dense 4D human correspondence from a set of monocular RGB images.
Its predictions assemble observations of the body, clothing and hair into a coherent reference-time geometry, including regions hidden in the reference image. • We decouple correspondence estimation from camera-pose and scene-motion recovery.
Dense4D supports direct matching across long temporal intervals and integrates with scene reconstruction through shared image pixels. • We introduce an amodal 3D localisation protocol on 4D-DRESS, measuring how closely observations across time align with the full reference-time scan.
We also evaluate 4D point tracking on the human queries of the existing TAPVid-3D Panoptic Studio benchmark.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A shared body template allows pixels on different people to be related through common anatomical coordinates ( Güler et al., 2018 ) .
BodyMap and TemporalUV extend this association to clothing and hair ( Ianina et al., 2022 ; Xie et al., 2022 ) , while HumanGPS learns scan-supervised embeddings shared across subjects ( Tan et al., 2021 ) .
These coordinates and embeddings establish correspondence but do not themselves reconstruct the individual’s body, garment or hair geometry.
Mesh reconstruction methods such as 4DHumans ( Goel et al., 2023 ) achieve body correspondence thanks to the fixed topology of the underlying parametric model, but do not represent the geometry and independent motion of garments or hair.
Dense4D provides personalised correspondence : HPMs reconstruct reference-time points and locate later observations on them, without a shared body template.
blocks.zh:
一个共享的身体模板允许不同人身上的像素通过共同解剖坐标来相通(Güler等,2018年).
BodyMap和TemporalUV将这种关联扩展到了服装和发型(Ianina等,2022;Xie等,2022;而HumanGPS学习了跨学科共享的扫描监督嵌入(Tan等,2021).
这些坐标和嵌入可建立通信,但本身并不重建个人的身体、衣服或发型几何。
4D Humans(Goel等,2023年)等网格重建方法由于基础参数模型的固定地貌而实现了身体对应,但不代表服装或发型的几何和独立的运动.
Dense4D提供个性化的通信: HPMs重建了参考时间点并定位后期的观测,没有共享的正文模板.

blocks.en:
ReLoo and DressRecon fit personalised surfaces, appearance and body/clothing deformation models to video through differentiable rendering ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) .
Their temporal correspondences follow the fitted 3D deformation fields used to render the reconstructed motion.
Forge4D reconstructs pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians from uncalibrated sparse-view videos and predicts their motion between adjacent timestamps for novel-view and novel-time synthesis ( Hu et al., 2026 ) .
Dense4D establishes correspondence across a set of monocular RGB images through a common human reference-time geometry, with correspondence and depth learned from dense 3D supervision.
blocks.zh:
ReLoo和DressRecon将个性化的表面,外观和身体/服装变形模型通过可分辨的渲染来进行录像(Guo等,2024;Tan等,2025.).
它们的时空通信遵循了用于使被重建的运动被安装的3D变形场.
Forge4D从未校正的稀有取景视频中重建了像素相通的3D高斯人,并预测了他们在相邻的时间戳之间的运动,用于小说取景和小说取景合成(Hu等,2026年).
Dense4D通过人类常见的参考时间几何来建立跨越一组单相光的RGB图像的通信,从密集的3D监督中学习到通信和深度.

blocks.en:
From Particle Video ( Sand & Teller, 2006 ) to learned models ( Harley et al., 2022 ; Doersch et al., 2023 ; Karaev et al., 2025 ) , image point trackers estimate query trajectories through occlusion.
Three-dimensional trackers add depth or geometric estimation ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Ngo et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
HPMs also locate points in 3D at the reference time even when hidden in the reference image.
blocks.zh:
从粒子视频(Sand & Teller,2006年)到学习模型(Harley等,2022年;Doersch等,2023年;Karaev等,2025年),图像点追踪器通过被隔离来估计查询轨迹.
三维跟踪仪增加了深度或几何估计(萧等,2024;萧等,2025;恩哥等,2025;张等,2025.).
HPMs甚至在参考图像中隐藏时也会在3D中定位点.

blocks.en:
NOCS predicts category-level object coordinates ( Wang et al., 2019 ) ; CaSPR learns a canonical spatiotemporal space from dynamic point clouds ( Rempe et al., 2020 ) .
DualPM pairs posed and rest-pose maps for quadrupeds ( Kaye et al., 2025 ) ; Face Anything predicts template-aligned facial coordinates and depth ( Kocasari et al., 2026 ) .
Dense4D instead matches observations of a deforming person using that person’s own reference-time geometry.
blocks.zh:
NOCS预测类别级天体坐标(Wang等,2019年;CaSPR从动态点云中学习出一个舟形相片空间(Rempe等,2020年).
DualPM对四面体地图和休眠图(Kaye等人,2025年); 任何东西都预言出模板相通的面部坐标和深度(Kocasari等,2026年).
相反,Dense4D与一个使用自己参考时间几何的变形人的观察相匹配。

blocks.en:
Point-map models represent pixels from different images as 3D points in a shared reference camera frame ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Leroy et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) .
Human-aware models add person outputs: HAMSt3R adds segmentation and DensePose to MASt3R ( Rojas et al., 2025 ) , while Human3R recovers SMPL-X bodies with scene geometry and cameras from monocular video ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
点映射模型在共享的参考相机框中作为3D点代表不同图像的像素(Wang等,2024a; Leroy等, 2024; Wang等, 2025a.).
人认识模型会增加人输出:HAMSt3R在MAST3R中会增加分化和DensePose(Rojas等,2025年),而Human3R则会从单相机视频中取回有场景几何和相机的SMPL-X尸体(Chen等,2026年).

blocks.en:
Feed-forward models extend point-based reconstruction to dynamic scenes ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026a ) , often jointly training geometry, motion and camera predictors ( Karhade et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Sucar et al., 2026 ) .
Building on predicted geometry, 4D Primitive-Mâché uses dense image correspondences to optimise rigid-primitive motion and aggregate observations across time ( Mazur et al., 2026 ) .
Dynamic Point Maps and V-DPM are closest to our representation: they express observations at a shared reference time and viewpoint, allowing correspondence to be established by matching shared-space coordinates ( Sucar et al., 2025 ; Sucar et al., 2026 ) .
Dense4D tracks by matching rather than by decoding point motion: every observed person pixel is mapped to the reference surface, correspondences are found among the target frame’s observed pixels, and each match is lifted with that frame’s own predicted depth.
Tracks therefore lie on the target frame’s predicted geometry by construction; visibility is estimated from the matching residual, and no motion or camera-pose prediction is required for camera-space tracking.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward模型将点基重建扩展到动态场景(冯等,2025;张等,2026;蒋等,2026a),经常联合训练几何,运动和相机预测器. (Karhade等,2025;Luo等,2026;Sucar等,2026).
在预测几何的基础上,4D Primitive-Mâché使用密集的图像对应来优化刚性-原始运动和跨时间的综合观测(Mazur等,2026年).
动态点地图和V-DPM最接近于我们的表示:它们在一个共同的参考时间和观点上表达观察,允许通过匹配共享-空间坐标来建立通信(Sucar等,2025;Sucar等,2026).
Dense4D轨迹通过匹配而不是解码点运动:每个被观测到的人像素被映射到参考地表,在目标帧所观测到的像素中发现对应物,每个匹配物被解除与该帧自身所预测的深度.
因此,轨迹位于目标框架按构造预测的几何上;能见度是根据相匹配的残基来估计的,照相机空间跟踪不需要运动或相机的预测。

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 4.2 4D point tracking on Panoptic Studio Humans
blocks.zh: 4.2 Panoptic Studio Humans上的4D点跟踪

blocks.en:
We evaluate the human-query subset of TAPVid-3D Panoptic Studio ( Koppula et al., 2024 ; Joo et al., 2019 ) , which we refer to as Panoptic Studio Humans .
We retain all 156 clips of 150 frames, evaluating the same set of queries on people across methods.
We report average Jaccard (AJ), average percentage of points within the depth-adaptive thresholds (APD), and occlusion accuracy (OA), using the official evaluator.
VGGT- Ω \Omega depth sets the relative scale of people; our model supplies their geometry and correspondences.
We adapt the outputs of V-DPM, 4RC and Any4D to the benchmark camera intrinsics without using ground-truth 3D.
Further protocol details are given in Sec. C.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们评价了TAPVid-3D Panoptic Studio的人类-query子集(Koppula等,2024;Joo等,2019),我们称之为Panoptic Studio Humans.
我们保留了全部156个片段的150个帧,评价了同样一套对不同方法的人的询问.
我们利用官方评价人员报告Jaccard(AJ)平均数、深度适应阈值(APD)内的平均分数和隔离精度。
VGGT - complete\Omega 深度设定了人们的相对规模;我们的模型提供他们的几何和对应.
我们把V-DPM、4RC和Any4D的输出结果适应基准相机的内在特性,而不使用地真立体。
议定书的详情见第C.1节。

Our model obtains 38.4 AJ, 50.3 APD and 89.6 OA ( Sec. 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Amodal 3D localisation on 4D-DRESS
blocks.zh: 4.3 4D-Dress上的三维定位模式

blocks.en:
Localising observations at a common reference time requires predictions for regions that may be hidden in the reference image.
We introduce an amodal 3D localisation evaluation on 4D-DRESS ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , whose synchronised images and scans let us test whether points observed across time agree with the person’s full reference-time geometry.
Because the scan covers regions hidden in the reference image, observations revealed later in the video can also be evaluated in the reference pose.
Small distances indicate close agreement with measured geometry, providing a stricter test than coarse localisation near the body.
blocks.zh:
在一个共同的参考时间进行定位观测,需要对可能隐藏在参考图像中的区域进行预测.
在4D-DRESS(Wang等人,2024年b)上引入了一种模式 3D 本地化评价,其同步图像和扫描让我们测试跨时间观测到的点是否与个人的全参考时间几何一致.
由于扫描覆盖了被隐藏在参考图像中的区域,视频后期所揭示的观测结果也可以被评价为参考平面.
相距小表示与测量到的几何学有密切的一致,提供了比身体附近粗细地分化更严格的测试.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Reference-time reconstruction from sixteen observations on 4D-DRESS. Left: input frames, with the reference boxed.
For each method, four viewpoints show the union coloured by source appearance (top) and distance to the scan from 0 to 5 cm (bottom).
The measured scan is overlaid in blue-grey in the top row.
blocks.zh:
图3:4D-DESS的16个观测结果的参考时间重建。 左:输入框,并有引用框.
对于每种方法,有四种观点显示由源外观(上)和从0到5厘米(下方)到扫描距离所组成的结合颜色.
测量到的扫描用上行的蓝灰色覆盖.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 128 distinct dynamic takes, with one sixteen-frame window per take beginning at its first frame.
All methods receive the same person crops from one camera, with the first frame as the reference.
HPMs directly predict the reference-time positions of all foreground pixels; V-DPM ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) and 4RC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) decode each frame at that same reference time.
We combine the sixteen point maps into one cloud and report the mean one-sided point-to-scan distance, using the full reference scan.
The distance is one-sided because the input views need not cover the full reference scan.
Each method discards its own least confident 5 % of points across the whole union.
This one-sided point-to-scan distance measures geometric agreement across time, though proximity to the scan alone cannot establish exact point identity. We assess temporal matching through point tracking on Panoptic Studio Humans ( Sec. 4.2 ) and discuss the limits of these evaluations in Sec. 5 .
blocks.zh:
我们评价128个不同的动态数据,每个数据从第一个数据框架开始,一个16个框架窗口。
所有方法都从一相机接收同人作物,以第一相框为参考.
HPM直接预测所有前地像素的参考时间位置;V-DPM(Sucar等,2026年)和4RC(Luo等,2026年)在同一参考时间解码出每个帧.
我们把16个点的地图合并成一个云,并报告平均的一面点对扫描距离,使用完整的参考扫描.
距离是片面的,因为输入视图不需要覆盖完整的参考扫描.
每一种方法都会丢弃自己最不自信的5%的分数。
这种片面的点对扫描距离测量跨时间几何协议,虽然仅靠扫描无法确定准确的点名. 我们通过Panoptic Studio Humans(第4.2节)的点跟踪评估时间匹配,并在第5节讨论这些评价的限度。

blocks.en:
Our union lies less than 1 cm from the measured surface on average: 0.86 cm, compared with 2.31 cm for V-DPM and 4.84 cm for 4RC ( Sec. 4.3 ).
Even with identical person-centred crops and little global translation, Dense4D achieves substantially more accurate surface localisation than the evaluated dynamic scene models.
Points from non-reference frames are nearly as accurate as those from the reference frame (0.87 versus 0.80 cm), and only 6.8 % lie more than 2 cm from the surface, compared with 41.5 % and 53.4 % for the baselines.
For both baselines, reference-frame predictions have lower error than those from other frames: 1.64 versus 2.36 cm for V-DPM and 4.07 versus 4.89 cm for 4RC.
blocks.zh:
我们的结合平均离所测量的地表不到一厘米:0.86厘米,而V-DPM为2.31厘米,4RC为4.84厘米(第4.3节)。
即使在以人为中心的相同作物以及几乎没有全球翻译的情况下,Dense4D的地表定位比评价的动态场景模型要精确得多。
非参照框架的点几乎与参照框架的点一样准确(0.87对0.80厘米),只有6.8%的点离地表2厘米以上,而基线为41.5%和53.4%。
对于这两个基准,参照框架的预测误差低于其他基准:V-DPM的误差为1.64相差2.36厘米,4RC的误差为4.07相差4.89厘米.

blocks.en:
Section 4.3 shows how error varies with time and confidence.
Our error stays within approximately 0.1 cm of the reference-frame value across the plotted temporal range.
V-DPM’s error rises by about 0.8 cm within the first second and then levels off, while 4RC’s grows gradually, by about 1.3 cm over the first two seconds.
Increasing the confidence cut from 0 to 50 % reduces 4RC’s error from 5.86 to 2.78 cm and V-DPM’s from 2.70 to 1.85 cm, while ours changes from 0.93 to 0.77 cm.
Confidence filtering therefore reduces the baselines’ errors more strongly, while our unfiltered predictions already lie within 1 cm of the surface on average. Figure 3 shows one test case for the three methods, with further examples in Fig. 14 .
blocks.zh:
第4.3节显示,错误因时间和信心而异。
我们的误差停留在大约0.1厘米的参考框架值范围内,跨越所规划的时间范围。
V-DPM的误差在第一秒内上升了约0.8厘米,然后变平,而4RC的误差则在前两秒内逐渐增加约1.3厘米.
将置信度从0到50 %将4RC的误差从5.86公分降至2.78公分,V-DPM的误差从2.70公分降至1.85公分,而我们的误差则从0.93公分降至0.77公分.
因此,通过信心过滤可以更有力地减少基线错误,而我们的未过滤预测则已经平均在地表一厘米以内。 图3显示了三种方法的一个试验案例,图14提供了进一步的例子。

On DAVIS ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) , Dense4D’s transferred points follow the moving person more faithfully than those of V-DPM and 4RC, whose transfers exhibit displaced or repeated body parts. Figure 5 summarises this visual advantage with matched forward-transfer overlays and reference-time unions, where our predictions form a more coherent human surface.
Additional sequences illustrate body rotation and clothing deformation ( Figs. 1 , 4 and 11 ).
The same reference-space matching supports tracking over long intervals: Dense4D processes 1,287 person crops from an 86 s video in one forward pass ( Fig. 10 ).

在DAVIS(Pont-Tuset等,2017年)上,Dense4D的调出点比V-DPM和4RC的调出点更忠实地跟随移动人,他们的调出点显示出了被转移或反复的身体部位. 图5总结了这种视觉优势,并配有相匹配的前向转移叠加和参照时间结合,其中我们的预测形成了更连贯的人类表面.
其他序列说明身体自转和服装变形(图1、图4和图11)。

Notice the distinct body outline preserved by Dense4D, compared with the overlapping limbs and dispersed points in the baseline unions.
(B) Frame-zero points transferred to the target image, with their original colours retained against a dimmed background.
These colours allow direct inspection of alignment between corresponding body regions.

blocks.en:
The comparisons distinguish plausible reconstruction in each frame from consistent transfer of the same surface points across time.
The additional views in Fig. 12 show this directly: the evaluated dynamic scene systems can reconstruct recognisable bodies yet place transferred points away from their own surfaces.

比较区分了每个框架的可信重建与同一地表点的连续转移。
图12中的额外视图直接显示了这一点:被评价的动态场景系统可以重建可辨认出的身体而将转移的点从自己的表面放置出.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
Dense4D recovers dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair without a body template.
Its Human Point Maps assemble observations from different frames into coherent human geometry in the reference pose, with aligned body parts and fine surface detail.
Dense4D separates correspondence from camera-pose and scene-motion estimation while keeping tracks consistent with its predicted human geometry by construction.
Compared with the baselines, Dense4D produces more precise trajectories and a better fit to measured human geometry, with videos showing robust tracking through articulation and clothing deformation.
Dense4D can also be integrated with scene point clouds simply through shared image pixels.
blocks.zh:
Dense4D恢复了整个身体,服装和发型上密集的4D通信,没有身体模板.
它的人类点 地图将不同框架的观测结果汇编成参考姿势中一致的人类几何,并有对齐的身体部分和精细的地表细节.
Dense4D从相机-pose和场景-运动估计中分离出对应物,同时通过构造使其轨迹与其预测的人类几何相符合.
与基线相比,Dense4D产生更精确的轨迹并更适合被测量到的人类几何,视频显示通过发音和服装变形进行强力跟踪.
Dense4D也可以简单地通过共享图像像素与场景点云相融合.

blocks.en:
Self-contact can make reference-space correspondence ambiguous when distinct surface points coincide.
Selecting a reference frame without self-contact, when available, is a relatively straightforward mitigation that we do not pursue here.
A broader challenge is evaluating correspondence on real people: 4D-DRESS measures proximity to scans rather than point identity, while Panoptic Studio Humans relies on reconstruction-derived trajectory labels that may inherit reconstruction errors.
Synthetic data provides exact correspondence, but domain differences limit its relevance to real images.
Evaluation of scene integration remains open as well: our visualisations demonstrate effective integration with scene point clouds, but its accuracy has not yet been measured quantitatively.
blocks.zh:
当不同的地表点相通时,自我接触可以使参考-空间通信变得模糊.
在没有自我接触的情况下,选择一个参考框架,是一种比较直接的缓解,我们在此不追求。
一个更广泛的挑战是评价关于真实人物的通信: 4D-DRESS测量了扫描的相近性,而不是指向点身份;而Panoptic Studio Humans则依赖于重建衍生出可能继承重建错误的轨迹标签.
合成数据提供精确的对应,但域差异将其相关性限制在真实图像上.
对场景融合的评价也依然开放:我们的可视化显示与场景点云的有效融合,但其准确性尚未被量化地测量.

blocks.en:
Temporal and multi-view consistency losses on large corpora of real video could improve correspondence and reduce reliance on synthetic supervision.
Developing real-data benchmarks with independently measured surface-point identities would strengthen evaluation beyond surface proximity and reconstruction-derived tracks.
The alignment provided by Dense4D could support learning appearance models based on Gaussian splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) from humans in motion, while its accurate tracks could control human motion in generated video ( Geng et al., 2025 ) .
Dense4D provides a foundation for augmenting scene understanding systems with more faithful human geometry, dense correspondence and robust tracking.
Building on this foundation, future work could develop richer models of people and their surroundings that remain coherent through prolonged motion and interaction.
blocks.zh:
对真实视频的大公司进行时间性和多视图一致性损失可以改善通信,并减少对合成监督的依赖。
制定具有独立测量的地表点特性的实际数据基准,将加强超出地表相近和由重建产生的轨道的评价。
由 Dense4D 提供的校正可以支持基于高斯平板化(Kerbl等,2023年)的学习外观模型,而其准确的轨迹可以控制生成视频中的人类运动(Geng等,2025年).
Dense4D为以更忠实的人类几何学,密集的通信与强力跟踪来增强场景理解系统提供了基础.
在这个基础上,今后的工作可以发展出更丰富的人及其周围环境模式,通过长期运动和互动保持连贯性。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work uses existing research datasets and publicly available video footage, including clips from Pexels (n.d.) , in accordance with their respective terms of use.
No new recordings of people were collected.
Training uses BEDLAM2, THuman2.1 and MammaSyn; evaluation includes existing benchmarks of real videos and 3D scans.
Dense4D estimates human geometry and correspondence without predicting biometric identity.
Applications should respect the consent and privacy of the people depicted.
blocks.zh:
这项工作根据各自的使用条件,利用现有的研究数据集和公开的录像,包括来自Pexels(n.d.)的剪辑.
没有收集到新的录音。
培训使用BEDLAM2,THuman2.1和MammaSyn;评价包括真实视频和3D扫描的现有基准.
Dense4D在不预测生物特征的情况下估算出人类几何和函数.
申请应尊重被描绘的人的同意和隐私。

blocks.en:
Our experiments do not assess demographic differences in performance or suitability for consequential decisions about individuals.
The underlying datasets and pretrained models remain subject to their respective terms of use.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验并不评估在业绩或是否适合对个人作出相应决定方面的人口差异。
基本数据集和经过预先培训的模型仍须遵守各自的使用条件。

blocks.en:
Holding out every tenth BEDLAM2 ( Tesch et al., 2025 ) track leaves 27,727 training tracks (1,250,307 labelled frames) and 3,081 development tracks, with 1,454 subjects across the two subsets.
The official test split contains 7,157 tracks and 181,263 labelled frames from 1,223 subjects.

官方的测试分会包含有1,223个主体的7,157个轨迹和181,263个标签框.

blocks.en:
Body and camera labels are available every fifth frame of the 30 fps video, giving supervision at 6 Hz.
The surfaces comprise neutral SMPL-X bodies ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) , garments with fixed topology across time, and hair envelopes derived from strand grooms.
blocks.zh:
机身和相机标签在30个fps视频中每5个帧都可以得到,在6Hz提供监听.
表面由中性SMPL-X体组成(Pavlakos等,2019年),有固定地形的长相外衣,由花边新郎所衍生出发封.

blocks.en:
For each groom, we extract the 0.3 level set of a strand-density field, offset it 3 mm inward and decimate it to 25 % of its faces ( Lorensen & Cline, 1987 ; Garland & Heckbert, 1997 ) .
We observe no independently simulated hair motion in the BEDLAM2 renders.
The envelope vertices are bound to head triangles and transported with the posed head. Figure 7 shows the envelopes used in Fig. 6 (A).
Compared with the renderer’s hair mattes, the envelopes achieve approximately 92 % precision and 84 % recall.
blocks.zh:
对于每个新郎来说,我们提取出0.3级的一圈线密度场,将其向内抵消出3毫米并造成其25%的相貌(Lorensen & Cline,1987;Garland & Heckbert,1997)。
在BEDLAM2中我们没有观察到任何独立的模拟发动。
信封顶部被绑入头部三角形并用被摆放的头来运输. 图7显示图6(A)中使用的信封。
与制造器的发垫相比,信封的精度约为92%,还原率为84%。

blocks.en: A.2 THuman2.1

We train on 2,200 of the 2,445 textured THuman2.1 ( Yu et al., 2021b ) scans, holding out every tenth scan.
Each scan is rendered from 50 cameras on a jittered orbit: elevation [ − 10 ∘ , 25 ∘ ] [-10^{\circ},25^{\circ}] , log-uniform vertical field of view [ 25 ∘ , 90 ∘ ] [25^{\circ},90^{\circ}] , off-centre aim and projected extent of 55 to 85 % of image height.
Images are 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 with panorama backgrounds sampled by camera ray.
RGB and labels share the same rasterisation.

blocks.en: A.3 MammaSyn
blocks.zh: A.3. 马马辛

blocks.en:
We train on 15,710 person tracks in 7,856 views from MammaSyn, MAMMA’s synthetic data family ( Cuevas-Velasquez et al., 2026 ) .
We retain cameras pitched downwards by at least 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} and every fourth frame.
MammaSyn complements BEDLAM2’s predominantly eye-level views and limited interactions with elevated views and interacting people, but its photorealistic SMPL-X renderings represent clothing only as texture, without separate garment or hair meshes.

blocks.en: B.1 Architecture and virtual cameras

blocks.en:
A 4 → 1024 → 1024 4\to 1024\to 1024 MLP with GELU activation embeds the crop geometry.
The ViT image encoder uses DINOv3-L ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) with patch size 16.
Each 512 × 512 512\times 512 crop supplies 1,024 patch tokens of width 1,024, which are joined by one camera token, 16 register tokens and the crop token.
Separate learned camera and register tokens identify the first frame as the reference; the remaining frames share a second set.
Camera tokens are internal features, with no camera-prediction head or camera-regression loss.
There are 24 pairs of frame and inter-frame attention blocks.
Five inter-frame blocks (indices 2, 6, 9, 14 and 20, zero-indexed) update only the camera, register and crop tokens; patch tokens pass through these steps unchanged.
The remaining 19 inter-frame blocks attend across all tokens.

Dense4D is trained for a cumulative 686,000 steps, taking approximately 490 hours on four GH200 GPUs.
We report the final checkpoint, without weight averaging.
AdamW ( Loshchilov & Hutter, 2019 ) uses weight decay 0.05 and peak learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , with linear warm-up and cosine decay.
Gradient norms are clipped to 1.0 separately for the backbone and each head; activation checkpointing covers attention-block pairs.

blocks.en: C.1 Panoptic Studio Humans
blocks.zh: C.1 光学工作室

blocks.en:
We evaluate 40,779 human queries across all 156 clips of 150 frames, retaining the Dynamic-3DGS pseudo-labels ( Luiten et al., 2024 ) .
Queries on held objects or with invalid annotations are excluded consistently across methods.
The official TAPVid-3D evaluator uses benchmark intrinsics, depth-adaptive thresholds and one median rescaling per clip; scores are averaged over clips.
The dataset contains 49 two-person and 107 single-person clips.

官方的TAPVid-3D评价员采用基准内在,深度适应阈值和每个剪辑一个中位再缩放;分数平均在剪辑上.
该数据集包含49个双人和107个单人剪辑.

blocks.en:
SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) supplies person masks, and the frame with the largest mask is selected as each person’s reference.
We fit one scale per person across the clip using pixel-aligned VGGT- Ω \Omega and predicted human depths on confident mask interiors.
The fit selects the scale supported by the most depth ratios within 5 %, then refines it using the median inlier ratio.
VGGT- Ω \Omega sets the scale only; our predicted depth supplies the track geometry, without temporal smoothing.

blocks.en: C.3 4D-DRESS: amodal 3D localisation

blocks.en:
Each of the 128 dynamic takes supplies sixteen frames from one camera, beginning at its first frame.
All methods receive identical crops and predict points at the first frame’s reference time.
blocks.zh:
每个128个动态都从一个相机中取出16个相框,从它的第一相框开始.
所有方法都得到相同的收成,并预测第一帧参考时间的分数.

blocks.en:
For each method, one similarity transform is robustly fitted using only reference-frame pixel correspondences to the scan, then applied unchanged to every frame’s predictions.
Each method discards its least confident 5 % of points across the sixteen-frame union; reference-frame and temporal statistics use this same retained point set.
We report mean one-sided point-to-scan distance in centimetres and the fractions exceeding 2 and 5 cm, averaging these statistics over takes.
The distance is one-sided because the observations do not cover the full scan; regions hidden in the reference image are included when observed in other frames.
Error bars are standard errors over takes.
blocks.zh:
对于每一种方法,一个相似性变换都是严格地安装的,只使用与扫描的参照像素对应,然后对每个帧的预测应用不变。
每种方法都放弃了16个框架的5%的最小信任点;参照框架和时间统计使用相同的保留点集。
我们报告是指一面点到扫描相距厘米,分数超过2和5厘米,平均这些统计数字超过摄取量。
相距是片面的,因为观测没有覆盖全扫描;在其他帧中观测时会包含参考图像所隐藏的区域.
出错栏是标准错误 。

blocks.en: C.4 Evaluation using synthetic data
blocks.zh: C.4 使用合成数据进行评价

blocks.en:
The conditioning ablation uses 128 tracks selected at a fixed stride through BEDLAM2’s sorted official test split, with four evenly spaced frames per track.
We measure Euclidean distance from each predicted point to its ground-truth reference-time position.
Known reference-camera geometry and each clip’s ground-truth scale ( Eq. 2 ) convert errors to centimetres before averaging, without fitted alignment or confidence filtering.
The temporal analysis uses the same error and scale convention ( Sec. D.2 ).
blocks.zh:
调制宽用通过BEDLAM2排序的官方测试分出在固定步道上选择的128个轨迹,每个轨迹有四个均匀的相距框.
我们测量了欧几利得从每个预测点到地面真实参考时间的距离。
已知的参考相机几何和每个片段的地真分量(Eq. 2)将出错转换为厘米后再平均,没有安装对齐或置信过滤.
时间分析采用相同的误差和尺度公约(第D.2.节)。

blocks.en: D.1 Crop zoom and viewing direction
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 裁剪缩放和取景方向

blocks.en:
The crop embedding encodes both the centre ray and crop zoom ( Eq. 3 ); we examine their roles separately.
Removing the entire embedding increases BEDLAM2 pointwise reconstruction error from 2.99 to 4.06 cm and reduces Panoptic Studio Humans tracking from 38.4 to 30.4 AJ and from 50.3 to 41.4 APD ( Tab. 2 ).
The unconditioned variant has higher reconstruction error on 111 of 128 test tracks and lower tracking AJ on 150 of 156 clips.
blocks.zh:
作物嵌入编码为中线和作物缩放(Eq. 3);我们分别审查它们的作用。
移除整个嵌入会将BEDLAM2指向重建出错从2.99公分增加到4.06公分,并将Panoptic Studio Humans的跟踪从38.4AJ和50.3APD(Tab. 2)减少为41.4A.
无附加条件的变体在128个测试道中的111个有较高的重建出错,在156个片段中的150个有更低的跟踪AJ.

blocks.en:
Retaining crop zoom while fixing the three centre-ray channels to ( 0 , 0 , 1 ) (0,0,1) at inference gives equivalent reconstruction and tracking performance at the reported precision.
This is expected because the rotation-induced homography already reorients each crop towards the person.
The result suggests that crop zoom carries the useful conditioning information after this rectification.
The reported checkpoint retains the centre-ray inputs used during training, but their variation provides no measurable benefit in this experiment.

保留作物放大,同时将三个中光通道固定为(0,0,1) (0,0,1),推论以报告的精确度进行等效的重建和跟踪性能.
这是因为自转引发的相片已经将每种作物都重新定向到人身上。
结果显示,作物缩放在本次校正后带有有用的调节信息.
所报告的检查站保留了培训期间使用的中央射线投入,但其变化无法在这项试验中提供可衡量的效益。

blocks.en: D.2 Temporal extent and input density
blocks.zh: D.2 时间范围和投入密度

blocks.en:
We use all official-test BEDLAM2 tracks lasting at least ten seconds (155 tracks, 139 subjects), including 25 that last sixteen seconds.
Windows start at the reference frame and span 1 to 16 s, sampled at 6 fps for up to 96 frames per forward pass.
Evaluation follows Sec. C.4 ; Fig. 9 reports means and standard errors over tracks.
Over a fixed sixteen-second interval, varying the input from 4 to 96 frames gives reconstruction errors of 3.5 to 3.7 cm, including frame counts above the usual training maximum of 24.
Extending the interval from one to sixteen seconds increases error from 2.5 to 3.6 cm, while reference-frame error remains approximately 2.0 cm.
Point-to-surface distance remains between 0.87 and 0.92 cm, suggesting that the additional pointwise error primarily concerns localisation along the surface.

blocks.en: E.3 Forward-transfer consistency on DAVIS

blocks.en:
Figure 12 compares frame-0 points transferred by Dense4D, V-DPM, 4RC and Any4D with each method’s own target-time surface, extending the overlays in Fig. 5 .
Several methods reconstruct recognisable human geometry at the target time, yet place transferred points away from that geometry.
This reveals inconsistency between their point-transfer and depth predictions, even when the target surface itself looks plausible.
Dense4D instead matches target-image pixels and lifts them with their predicted depth, so transferred points lie on its target surface by construction.
The height colours help assess alignment with the corresponding body regions; proximity to a method’s own surface alone does not establish correspondence accuracy.
blocks.zh:

有几种方法在目标时间重建了可识别的人类几何学,然而却将移位点与该几何学相去甚远.
这表明,即使目标表面本身看起来是合理的,但它们的点移和深度预测之间也不一致。
Dense4D取而代之,将目标图像像素相匹配,并用所预测的深度将其提升,因此被转移的点会通过构造来放在目标表面.
高度颜色有助于评估与相应身体区域的一致性;接近某一方法本身表面并不能确定对应准确性。
